observations.topic: Three complete typed guard bodies preserve native source
observations.result: NextCharterPlanBasisFailureConstraintV1, NextCharterPlannerFailureConstraintV1 and AssessNextCharterPlanCommandConstraintV1 exactly match original bodies after replacing typed constraints with their code literals, typed helper names with originals and string-to-var locals. All 27 origin path/line/code triples match original67f. Legacy signatures/default optional argument and out initialization remain; wrappers return NativeCode. Start, inspect, pause/cancel/resume/finalize branches retain source order.

NativeReadContextV1 now stores the Simulation's exact verificationOrigin privately. IsBoundTo(origin,candidate) first rejects null/foreign origin by reference and then delegates to unchanged exact-snapshot/current-stamp/schema/wire-schema/clock/fingerprint/TestOnly checks. CurrentReadContext still validates current owner/policy/generation against both authoritative state and captured snapshot before construction. The constructor remains internal, not public; the new overload returns only a comparison result. Equal content bytes from another Simulation cannot transfer its context to this owner.

The private sealed checkpoint accepts only StartNextCharterPlan with selected verifiedPlanningPassage, actual retained passage, exact origin-bound context, VerifyOwner success and full pure canonical predecessor equality. VerifyOwner checks exact retained owner, policy/content fingerprint, current revision/TestOnly/wire schema and passage.Covers for the current revision. An old checkpoint or changed captured state fails before native planning guards. A native read context alone does not grant this proof.

observations.topic: Pure canonical comparison and callback boundary
observations.result: MatchesValidatedPredecessor invokes the existing private EncodeCanonical writer and byte equality; it does not call public validating Encode, Decode, Validation.Snapshot, policy.ValidateState, Seal or VerifyNext. Reused CODEC_TRANSITIVE_SOURCE_AUDIT supplies the broader writer closure; this review did not repeat it. Origin/context checks use concrete private fields and sealed/owning stamp values, not a policy projection Stamp getter or callback. No new external callback or owner reentry route was introduced.

Checkpoint missing/mismatch returns VerificationUnavailableAt. AssessInitialFactsV1 additionally requires a present passage covering the full current revision whenever a planning profile exists, before calling shared initial guards. A valid proof with no qualifying completion remains present and Covers succeeds; basis then uses StartThrough(close.SourceRevision)==0 and returns the original native NextCharterPlanningPassageEvidenceMissing at113. The earlier missing-member case at106 remains distinct. Missing technical proof is not relabelled as native missing evidence.

observations.topic: Legacy fallback cannot execute from checked read path
observations.result: The shared basis still contains its original optional legacy FindPlanningPassage fallback for execution behavior. In the new Start read route, mandatory owner/current proof has already passed Covers at current.Revision; on validated current close records its SourceRevision is within that cutoff, so the basis follows StartThrough and cannot reach fallback. Previous job passage is used only in original non-Start paths. FindPlanningPassage now calls RequireExecution(HistoryReplay) before Initial or receipt replay, catching any future accidental read entry. Its behavior outside a read inspection remains unchanged. No read constructs, repairs, extends or advances passage evidence.

observations.topic: Root ordering and existing nonplanning behavior
observations.result: Factoring AssessInitialFactsV1 retains the existing strict condition EnterRead and initial WorldOpening/long-rest/Sanctuary/Guidance/physical sequence. Planning joins BeforeStabilizationBranchConstraintV1 at its actual native dispatch stage, before later meal/route/general work gates. Native planner-specific source, window, capability and off-calendar checks retain order. The public policy interface still rejects direct use for RequiresVerifiedAssessment; ordinary nonplanning routing uses the same private helper with null passage and unchanged guard sequence. Planning without a selected profile can return its native not-selected guard; a selected profile without owned proof fails closed.

The checkpoint class remains private and sealed; NativeReadContext construction remains internal. The new public context overload compares identity without exposing origin or constructing authority. VerificationUnavailableAt only creates an immutable native diagnostic with null eligibility/commit/constraint/receipt and default audit counters; it authenticates no state and grants no permission. Core AssessCommandFactsV1 still performs command/authority/revision/idempotency checks before invoking the verified checkpoint and attaches the active read audit afterward.

After pure source guards, ObserveNextCharterPlan remains a current readiness/supply projection over actual records and existing source helpers; no future movement or resource reservation is added. Prior spatial/speed/pressure/procedure/current-condition plans and audits are referenced without claiming a fresh full closure. BookNextCharterPlan, job append, active labor, timed progress/report creation and checkpoint advancement remain execution-only. InitialAssessmentV1 still uses CommitFeasibility=null.
